text.tspan: V-REVIEW · 一次 review 怎样穿过 ownership 与 enforcement boundaries
revision · transport · deployment · owner · evidence ceiling 决定 applicability、reference selection 与 claim ceiling
R0 / R1 · named authority + project interpretation · S0
R2 + preflight · controller 只选择这个 target 所需的 workflow 与 references
R3 · partially ordered execution · transport-specific admission → shared capability core → bounded evidence
后置 control 不能倒流保护已经消耗的 resource / state / authority
HTTP 仅在 applicable 时进入
partial order · ownership · state/effect · evidence discipline
缺失 evidence 保持 unknown
选择 profile + control family + refs
source inspection → project tests → function reproduction → runtime → named host → independent
DECISION RAIL · applicable finding / verified absence / not applicable / runtime-unknown / host-unknown / independent-unverified · U4 在对应 boundary 被观察前保持可见
